headline: Volkswagen Swings to Loss Following Impairment Writedown
summary: Volkswagen swung to a financial loss after recording a writedown as the automaker struggles with a rapidly worsening operating environment, particularly in China.
why: Automotive sector earnings and major writedowns highlight margin pressures from intensifying EV competition and weakening demand in key Asian markets.

impacts.name: Volkswagen AG
impacts.why: Asset writedowns and tough operating conditions in China directly reduce profitability and net earnings.
